name: Sundried Tomatoes
siboNotes: Generally well tolerated in small portions. The concentration process may increase flavor intensity, allowing smaller amounts to provide satisfying taste.
preparationTips: Soak oil-packed varieties briefly to reduce excess oil if desired
Chop finely to distribute flavor throughout dishes
Store opened jars in refrigerator for extended freshness
Choose varieties without garlic or onion additives
nutritionalHighlights: High in lycopene, a powerful antioxidant
